Is it me or does the terrain look awfully round? It seems to be more circular in morphology than triangular. But I am out of practice as looking at aerial photos.

However, I don't think it is too much of a stretch to consider erosion. I wouldn't expect Pluto to have much of an atmosphere, so I would imagine impact craters to be more pronounced. Not sure if Pluto's odd orbit allow it to get enough heat to affect seasons to change surface from solid to a liquid.

Albeit highly dispersed, Pluto's atmosphere is thin but it's there, and with such large variance in orbit and radiation, a Plutonic freeze/thaw weathering and erosion phenomenon would be awesome to read about. Simplegoats is a very simple and elegant looking theme. The main goal of this theme is to be clean, easy to navigate easy for new people to learn how to customize, and very simplistic. Less clutter means more focus on content.

The CSS is commented thoroughly for new users to apply and begin customizing. I am a C++ and C# developer, so CSS isn't completely new to me, but I am learning more about it every day.

The power in this theme isn't the default style, but it is what can be done with it. Everything is customizable from the colors to the placement of things, to the animations.

If you like it, don't like it, whatever, let me know! The theme is always evolving and as always I will release different features as snips so that you don't have to use the whole theme if you don't want to.

The mobile recognition and style will be coming soon, as I am currently researching the most efficient way to do it.

Mobile theme works, in light and dark. Version 1.0 has been released, get it in the sidebar, or use the one in the main page of github (it is what I would do). I only did a release so that I could go back and look at the code at that point. 1.5 shouldn't take too long to release, and won't be much different. It will be mostly a cleanup and bugfix release (maintenance).

Version 1.0 is deprecated. Use the link in the sidebar to get the latest code for the theme. It is more stable, better commented, and laid out better, not to mention more efficient.

If you choose to use Simplegoats on your verse, I will personally help you customize it if needed. I actually need the experience in CSS and I have the time right now. Sorry to say, life has gotten busy. I will still help when I can though.
